slides.title: The mountain book
slides.text: Nora has a book about mountains. The highest mountain is in Asia. The most popular mountain is in the Alps. The oldest mountain range is in Africa. The most beautiful one, in Nora's opinion, is the one near her grandmother's village, because it has snow all year and the best sunsets.
slides.pt: O livro de montanhas de Nora lista picos famosos, mas sua favorita é a da vila da avó.

qs.q: Qual é a favorita de Nora?
opts: The one near her grandmother's village
